title: [Bug] Slash Command Execution Fails in Custom Project Scope
body:
**Bug Description**
In release 0.2.101  Custom project scoped slash commands in .claude/command folder   ie: claude > /project:optimize 
 Hangs without response.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: WezTerm
- Version: 0.2.101
- Feedback ID: 120d1bc6-b78a-453f-a515-3213ea396818
author: danielscholl
